key_insights: Bitcoin has been in exceptionally tight 7-week range of 16.2-17.2K with almost no volatility despite significant macro catalysts and negative crypto news
Market is showing signs of reduced correlation with traditional markets - SP dumped while crypto didn't move, then SP up and crypto down
Bear market has been unusually severe with no counter-trend rallies on high timeframes for an entire year, creating recency bias against upside moves
Litecoin and TRX have been notable outperformers in BTC pairs since late 2020, suggesting relative strength
Industry continues to face contagion from centralized lending failures (DCG, Genesis, Silvergate) and exchange issues (Huobi, Voyager, Binance)
Dollar weakness has been supportive of risk assets but approaching 102-103 support level could create pressure if dollar bounces
